record.text: The weight of the iPhone duo is out and it’s 254g, which is quite chunky for a phone. To put it another way, it’s about a mars bar and a wispa 	bar heavier than my iPhone 15 pro.

Four thousand two hundred South Pacific pesos for the base model iPhone Duo. My brother in Christ that is too much for a phone. That’s two years worth of my overpriced electricity bills. That’s more than I spend on groceries in 6 months. That’s more than a MacBook Air and iPhone 17 combined.
